card.name: Words right before "rate"
card.fires_on: The word just before "rate" or "rates" in a phrase naming a measured proportion, such as success, graduation, cure, conviction or reporting.

modes.label: Social statistics rates
modes.description: Words like graduation, conviction or discontinuation before "rate" in statistics about groups of people.
